children: BlockBeats reported on September 10 that an address beginning with 0xf517 on Hyperliquid lowered its BTC add-on price again this morning while keeping the planned purchase size unchanged. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the address canceled a previous buy order for 385.72 BTC at $77,377 and replaced it with the same amount in a standard limit order at $76,377, with the current order valued at about $29.46 million.

As of press time, the address still held about 78.31 BTC in long positions, with a position value of about $6.137 million, an average entry price of $77,772.7, and unrealized gains of about $47,000. If all orders are filled, its BTC long position would expand to about 464.03 BTC. BTC was trading at about $78,368 at the same time, meaning it would need to fall about 2.5% to reach the new add-on price. TradingBeats has also launched an on-chain perpetuals and address analysis tool that supports real-time Hyperliquid data, from address tracing to whale activity analysis.

title: Hyperliquid Address Lowers BTC Add-On Price Again While Keeping Order Size Unchanged
